title: Bottom tab bar and back button navigation
when: The phone app needs a bottom tab bar for top level sections and a predictable back behavior, including the hardware back key in a Capacitor shell.
prompt:
Goal: A 3 to 5 item bottom tab bar where each tab keeps its own stack and scroll position, and back always goes to the previous screen before leaving the app.
Steps:
1. Markup: <nav aria-label="Main"> with <a href="#/home"> items, each holding an icon plus a short text label; mark the active one with aria-current="page".
2. router.js listens to hashchange (or popstate) and renders the screen; detail screens push a new entry, tab switches replace it.
3. Remember window.scrollY per tab in a Map and restore it after the render.
4. Tapping the active tab again scrolls to top, then pops to the tab root.
5. A visible back arrow in the header on detail screens calls history.back().
6. Capacitor: App.addListener("backButton", ({ canGoBack }) => canGoBack ? history.back() : App.exitApp()); close open sheets or dialogs first.
7. Pad the bar with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and keep it visible while scrolling.
Quality bar:
- Labels are always visible, not icon only.
- Back never skips a screen and never exits from a detail screen.
Pitfalls:
- Pushing a history entry on every tab tap, so back walks through tabs.
- More than 5 tabs; move extras into a "More" screen.
- Exiting while a dialog is open.
Verify:
- [ ] aria-current marks the active tab.
- [ ] Scroll position survives a tab round trip.
- [ ] The hardware back handler closes overlays first.
Output: tab bar markup in index.html, router.js and the bar CSS.

examples.input: app com abas embaixo: inicio, busca, perfil, e o botão voltar funcionando
examples.output: nav with aria-current tabs, per tab scroll memory, backButton listener that closes dialogs then goes back
